description: Heritage list-reporter alias profile gate (issue #669, slice H4): with the Heritage profile INACTIVE (Core + Data only), each list-reporter alias `bf`/`bl`/`se` is an unknown callee and is rejected with `ol-unknown-command` — including both `bf` and `bl` on the composed `bf bl [ … ]` line (line 4), proving the gate reaches aliases nested as arguments too, not just leading ones. Its did-you-mean points at the nearest VISIBLE Core word (never the alias itself or its full Core spelling, which are not in scope without the profile) — exactly the behavior any un-imported name gets. Activating the profile (see the sibling `heritage-list-reporter-aliases-accepted-when-active`) makes every one of them resolve silently. Spans point at the alias the learner wrote, in argument position (`print` occupies columns 1–6, so the alias starts at column 7).
